subject: you mean my bloggs have to
author: BootlegGiant
body:
you mean my bloggs have to be game related damn as I have just written a bad ass blogg about random stuff, oops I'm bad..

I first got onto xbox with Halo CE way befor broadband came to my area and I hated it I think the fact that a 11 year old was owning me on split screen pissed me off enough to sell it and get a PS2, but no man I think the first game I played was Star Wars something followed by Toca Race Driver I really got into that but not much people played it online and those that did were amazing at it, and thean I was in my local game shop (crappy Summit Games) in Bangor and I saw Burnout Takedown and thought to my self that looks good, I hated the actuall game but the online experiance was very good and yes I was hooked I went through 4 xbox's and about 4 or 5 disk's and probably played 50+ hours a week damn dude that game nearly cost me my job it was so addictive I had one friend that would play 16+ hours a day and yes he did loose his job, I  lost intrest in Takedown when I got very good and never lost a race maybe I played the wrong people I dont know but heck its boring winning all the time so I had to move on and Halo 2 was the choice I made and stayed with it for roughly 2 years and boy did I suck if it wasent for the fact that I played with very good people I dont think I would have stayed with it for so long, and thean with the release of revenge looming on the horizon I went back to takedown and met up with the old gang and damn I sucked and the rest is history dude, I have also like you always been a gamer I never had a Atari though, I think my first one was the ZX81 or 18 by spectrum and me and my mates used to play Horace goes sking and would swoon over the graphics hahahahaha, I never liked Sega and hence no consoles but I did by chance come across a Mega Drive it was cheep so yes but I was mostly into nintendo and Mario with a bit of Street Fighter, dude did you play that on Arcade I dont remember it being that hard, urm I have had all nintendo's up to N64 and PS1 PS2 have also been in my possesion, shoot is that the time got to go man laters..

The Drugs dont work!! ----English is my second language, feal free to flame me----

body:

By the way Boot i decided to have the afternoon off (isnt it ace when you can take off whenever you want?! sorry you cant do that can you despite being in charge hahahaha) to play a bit of M.O.H and i think i'm on a really hard level man... Got fed up with it actually and put Tiger Woods 08 in to generate my face with the vision camera and i look BIZARRE dude!
